title: SkyBlock items
summary: Every Hypixel SkyBlock item is in the game with its real name, SkyBlock ID, rarity and stats. With FurfSky Reborn installed, each one looks the way it does on Hypixel.

s.x: SkyRPG SkyBlock is being built as a 1:1 copy of Hypixel SkyBlock. The first piece is in:
all 5,680 SkyBlock items
, from
Enchanted Diamond
to
Hyperion
. Each one has Hypixel's name, SkyBlock ID, rarity, category and stats.
Where an item comes from (drops, recipes, shops, minions) arrives with the systems that use it, phase by phase. Until then, admins hand items out with
/sbitem
A SkyBlock item is a normal Minecraft item underneath, like on Hypixel: the
Aspect of the End
is a diamond sword, and the
Summoning Ring
is a player head. The item also carries its
SkyBlock ID
, the same one Hypixel uses.
The pack uses the
FurfSky Reborn
texture pack, through the
Catharsis

mod. Both read that ID and give each item its proper look: the Hyperion, Terminator and Necron's armour look like they do on Hypixel. Without the pack you see the base item instead, so a Hyperion is an iron sword. Heads always show their own skin, and leather armour keeps its colour.

FurfSky Reborn belongs to its own team. We never host it; your launcher downloads it from Modrinth along with the pack. It's always on. Only its item and armour looks are used (and its border round the selected hotbar slot); SkyRPG's own screens and menus stay as they are.
SkyBlock items use Hypixel's tooltip layout in SkyRPG's frame:
the name in its rarity colour;
the stats in Hypixel's order (Damage, Strength, Crit Chance, Crit Damage... then Health, Defense, Speed, Intelligence...);
the item's lore, in Hypixel's colours;
the rarity line in bold, like
LEGENDARY HELMET
Rarities run in Hypixel's order: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic,
Divine
(aqua), Special,
Very Special
Ultimate
and
Admin
. A Recombobulator (when it arrives) raises an item by one step, up to Divine.
Everything Hypixel puts on items is a SkyRPG stat now, with Hypixel's symbol. On top of the ones SkyRPG already had, these are new:
Combat:
Bonus Attack Speed, Ferocity, Ability Damage, True Defense, Swing Range, Health Regen, Vitality and Mending.
Mining:
Breaking Power, Pristine, Mining Spread, and Ore, Block, Dwarven Metal and Gemstone Fortune.
Farming and foraging:
a Fortune for each crop, plus Fig, Mangrove and Helix Fortune.
Fishing:
Double Hook Chance, Treasure Chance and Trophy Fish Chance.
Other:
Pet Luck, Bonus Pest Chance, Heat, Cold and Pressure Resistance, Respiration, Fear, Alchemy Wisdom, Tracking and Pull, and the Rift stats.
The skill XP stats are called
Wisdom
now, as on Hypixel: Farming Wisdom, Mining Wisdom, Foraging Wisdom, Combat Wisdom and Fishing Wisdom.
Some of these stats only do something once their system lands (the Rift, the Garden, the Crystal Hollows).
A SkyBlock item doesn't act like the vanilla item it's made from:
block items (enchanted blocks, heads, wool) don't place, unless Hypixel lets you place that item;
spawn-egg items (Decoys, Training Dummies) don't spawn their mob;
food, potions and throwables don't get eaten, drunk or thrown just because their base could.
Bows, crossbows, fishing rods, ender pearls and wearable items work as normal. Nothing wears out.
The
SkyBlock Items
page in the K menu has every SkyBlock item in a grid, sorted by rarity. Type to search by name or SkyBlock ID, and hover an item to see its full tooltip. Admins can click an item to get one.
